actions:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a production animation sprite sheet for a desktop pet named 熊猫烧香, using the supplied JPG as the character identity reference. Preserve its funny old-school Chinese internet panda: enormous round white head, tiny spiky tuft, rounded black ears with gray highlights, huge black eye patches with narrow horizontal white sleepy eye lines, shiny black paws, round white belly, tiny black legs, bold dark outlines, smooth simple gray shading. NOT realistic, NOT pixel art. Same character in every frame.
OUTPUT: transparent RGBA sprite atlas, exactly 8 columns by 8 rows of equal cells, ideally 2048x2048. No lines, no text, no labels, no ground/background, no shadows outside each character. Each cell contains exactly ONE entire panda pose centered within generous transparent margins. All 64 cells occupied. Do not let any sprite cross its cell. Consistent character size, eye design and style.
Each row is a left-to-right 8-frame animation:
ROW 1: panda rolls toward the right, arms tucked, sequential poses at 0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315 degrees, whole body tumbling. No incense while rolling.
ROW 2: panda rolls toward left, reverse somersault 0,-45,-90,-135,-180,-225,-270,-315 degrees.
ROW 3: panda laughs hilariously clutching its white belly with BOTH paws, mouth wide open, eyes squeezed shut, leaning back then forward shaking with laughter, eight varied poses. No laptop or incense.
ROW 4: happy small celebratory hop, squash then jump then land, both arms raised, eight distinct frames, no extra objects.
ROW 5: disappointed panda scratches head and wipes sweat, then regains confidence with a tiny clenched fist, eight sequential poses.
ROW 6: waiting panda sits holding a single small bamboo sprig, looks left then right, taps a foot, thoughtful face, eight poses.
ROW 7: panda takes a small silver laptop out beside its belly, opens laptop lid in first two poses, settles to actively typing with alternating black paws on keyboard in remaining six poses. Laptop screen faces panda; viewer sees gray back with NO LOGO. Panda face visible above laptop. Clear keyboard typing gesture.
ROW 8: panda reviews a tiny cream checklist held in one paw, marks a green check with pencil, then proudly gives thumbs up. Eight sequential poses.
Use clean alpha transparency; no checkerboard painted into image. The JPG is a visual reference only, remove its blue background. Preserve the distinctive original panda rather than creating a generic cute panda.
gaze: Create a transparent RGBA 4 columns x 4 rows sprite sheet, sixteen equal square cells, ONE panda in each cell with generous clear margins, no text/grid/background. Reference image defines identity: enormous round white head with little spiky tuft, black rounded ears with gray sheen, huge sleepy black eye patches with thin white horizontal eye slits, tiny body with white belly and black paws and feet, old Chinese internet cartoon panda, smooth soft gray shading and bold black outline. Panda holds three thin yellow incense sticks with red tips in both paws in front of chest as in reference. Same front-facing pose and body scale throughout. Change head tilt and gaze subtly across sixteen poses, reading left-to-right: look far left, up-left, upward, up-right, far right, down-right, downward, down-left; next row sequence alternate stronger head tilt of these same eight directions. Keep all incense tips and body fully visible, narrow wisps of smoke optional. Genuine alpha transparency. This is for native Codex desktop pet gaze frames, not a poster.
